owners.configuration: ferric-browser-config owns typed persisted models/validation/registry; application configuration owns atomic writes and shared profile/session application.
owners.application_state: ferric-browser-application owns profile sessions and orchestration; mutable browser state changes through the existing reducers/events.
owners.qt_webengine: ferric-browser-engine-qt owns WebEngine views, QML windows, native prompts and Qt callback delivery.
owners.profile_resources: Root-window FerricProfileResourceRegistry owns shared per-profile Qt resources; FerricProfileLifetime owns native view/window references and drain/release; ProfileSession weakly shares durable Rust state and does not retain it alone.
owners.delayed_requests: qml/scripts/EngineRequests.js routes captured requests only after exact tab/generation/document validation.
